clips.title: The story
paras: Calvin Montague is an opportunistic Forsaken rogue loitering near the exit gate of Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades. Preying on newly awakened undead as they leave the graveyard, he attempts to trick passersby into running errands on his behalf.

Positioned just outside the gates leading away from Deathknell, Calvin Montague embodies the ruthless pragmatism common among Lordaeron's restless dead. Rather than handling his own correspondence or paying fair courier rates, he attempts to smooth-talk wandering adventurers into delivering letters under false pretenses. While several other prominent undead bearing the Montague family name manage banking interests within the Undercity, Calvin pursues a decidedly less reputable trade, preferring petty schemes and deception.
